items.title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down

items.author: Julie Bort

items.author: Lucas Ropek
items.content: <article>Blackstone's forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its business.</article>

items.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
